tooltip_definitions.Total Consolidated Revenue: Consolidated GAAP net revenue from hydrogen fuel cell systems, GenEco electrolyzers, cryogenic transport, and hydrogen fuel delivery ($200.60M in Q3 2026, beating Street consensus $193.33M by +3.76%).
tooltip_definitions.Sales of Equipment & Infrastructure: Commercial equipment shipments including GenDrive fuel cell stacks, GenSure stationary power units, and hydrogen fueling dispensers ($105.74M in Q3 2026, up +9.3% YoY).
tooltip_definitions.Fuel Delivered to Customers: Liquid and gaseous hydrogen supply delivered across customer fleet networks ($38.11M in Q3 2026, up +6.1% YoY).
tooltip_definitions.Services on Fuel Cell Systems: Recurring maintenance contracts, technical support, and fleet service agreements ($29.01M in Q3 2026, jumping +47.0% YoY).
tooltip_definitions.Power Purchase Agreements (PPAs): Long-term equipment utilization and electricity generation agreements with industrial warehouse customers ($27.71M in Q3 2026).
tooltip_definitions.Gross Margin Improvement: Gross margin expanded ~65 percentage points YoY from -67.87% (-$120.17M) in Q3 2025 to -2.67% (-$5.36M) in Q3 2026, approaching gross margin breakeven.
tooltip_definitions.Operating Loss: Operating loss of -$75.25M in Q3 2026, down 78% YoY from -$348.79M (and -$246.88M operating loss) in Q3 2025 due to Project Quantum Leap cost reductions.
tooltip_definitions.Project Quantum Leap: Company-wide operating expense rationalization and supply chain restructuring initiative reducing quarterly OpEx by ~69% YoY to $69.90M.
tooltip_definitions.GAAP Basic EPS: GAAP basic net income per share of $0.07 in Q3 2026 ($99.77M net income attributable to Plug Power Inc.) benefiting from a $192M non-cash mark-to-market gain on debt/equity instruments.
tooltip_definitions.Quarterly Net Cash Usage: Net change in cash and cash equivalents (excluding restricted cash) of approximately $28.0M in Q3 2026, marking a 54% sequential reduction from $61.0M in Q2 2026.
tooltip_definitions.Operating Cash Flow: Operating cash flow of -$76.42M in Q3 2026, improving from -$94.06M in Q2 2026 and -$150.04M in Q1 2026.
tooltip_definitions.Capital Expenditures: Additions to property, plant, equipment, and PPA installations totaling $14.80M in Q3 2026, cut by more than half from $30.66M in Q2 2026.
tooltip_definitions.Reported Free Cash Flow: Operating cash flow (-$76.42M) minus CapEx ($14.80M), yielding reported negative free cash flow of -$91.22M in Q3 2026.
tooltip_definitions.Stock-Based Compensation: Non-cash equity incentives totaling $13.12M in Q3 2026 ($40.01M for nine months ended September 30, 2026).
tooltip_definitions.True Free Cash Flow: Economic cash burn subtracting CapEx ($14.80M) and SBC ($13.12M) from OCF (-$76.42M), totaling -$104.34M in Q3 2026.
tooltip_definitions.Arcadia eFuels Supply Agreement: Signed 280 MW GenEco electrolyzer supply agreement for Project ENDOR in Denmark and strategic partnership covering >1 GW of e-SAF projects.
tooltip_definitions.Electrolyzer Opportunity Funnel: Global pipeline of approximately $8.0B in commercial electrolyzer projects spanning sustainable aviation fuels, green ammonia, and industrial decarbonization.
tooltip_definitions.GenDrive Deployments: Deployed 1,136 commercial fuel cell units in Q3 2026, up 110% YoY compared to 540 units in Q3 2025.
tooltip_definitions.After-Hours Reaction: PLUG shares consolidated at $1.49 (-0.67%) after hours following a +2.7% regular session climb to $1.50, digesting the top-line beat against non-cash EPS dynamics.
